_doc: Suite recipes for measure-suite.sh (PROTOCOL §3.2). setup runs with network; test runs without (unshare -rn, loopback up). The test command is the repository's own unit-test target at the start commit.

_host.note: Logs of the counted runs were kept locally (~/bench-work/measure/<repo>-<commit>/{setup,offline,online}.log) and are not committed; suites.jsonl keeps every run, including superseded ones without a recipe hash.

werkzeug.setup: if [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv sync -q --locked -p 3.12 --no-default-groups --group tests; else uv venv -q -p 3.12 .venv && VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv uv pip install -q -r requirements/tests.txt -e .; fi

textual.setup: uv venv -q -p 3.12 .venv && VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv uvx --from 'poetry<2' poetry install -q --with dev --all-extras

preact.test: CHROME_BIN=$(command -v google-chrome || command -v chromium) npm run test:unit

emberjs.setup: PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install -g -s --prefix "$HOME/pnpm" pnpm@$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager.split('@')[1].split('+')[0]") && PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 "$HOME/pnpm/bin/pnpm" install --frozen-lockfile
emberjs.test: "$HOME/pnpm/bin/pnpm" vite build --mode=development && PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=$(command -v google-chrome || command -v chromium) "$HOME/pnpm/bin/pnpm" test

mermaid.setup: npm install -g -s --prefix "$HOME/pnpm" pnpm@$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager.split('@')[1].split('+')[0]") && CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY=0 PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 "$HOME/pnpm/bin/pnpm" install --frozen-lockfile
